summary: The only reports located are repetitions of the NAFDAC Public Alert No. 034/2026 regarding the Niger Republic's import ban on Bulmex Parboiled Rice from India due to metallic contamination. No other national regulator, WHO, regional agency, or independent credible news source has issued a separate alert or notice about this product or any specific batches.
